subject: Marketplace launch cadence & ops handoff — Alliance Shelf listing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace launch cadence & ops handoff — Alliance Shelf listing

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — excited about CloudBridge joining the Alliance Shelf. I want to set a short launch cadence so the listing and co-sell setup don't stall between our teams. Proposed next steps (short timeline):

- This week: exchange listing assets + SKU/pricing matrix + security evidence
- Next week: ops handoff call (30m) to validate billing and entitlement mapping
- Two weeks: submit GCP/AWS listing packages and start marketplace QA

To get us moving, can you share the following by Friday?
- Product listing pack (one-pager, screenshots, icons)
- Canonical SKU/pricing for marketplace (or expected mapping)
- Primary legal + billing contacts for procurement redlines
- Any restrictions on data residency or required security docs (SOC2, ISO)

I attached our Redwood Marketplace Launch Checklist to make the handoff cleaner. After you send materials I’ll loop in our listing ops engineer for the intake. If the timeline above is tight, tell me what works for you and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: Redwood-Marketplace-Launch-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Alliances
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch cadence & ops handoff — Alliance Shelf listing

Thanks Jasmine — +1 on the checklist. A couple of quick notes from GTM/enablement side:

- For co-sell entitlements we prefer a 3-tier SKU mapping (Starter / Pro / Enterprise). If CloudBridge can provide a simple CSV with usage tiers and metering keys, our billing team will map them to marketplace SKUs.
- We’ll need a 6‑month usage estimate for quota/burst capacity planning if you expect early customers.
- Procurement will ask for an order form template — if legal@cloudbridge can pre-send their preferred order language it speeds the contract step.

I attached a sample entitlement mapping and a blank pricing template to fill. Happy to join the ops sync once we have assets.

Attachments: Marketplace-Entitlement-Mapping.csv (csv)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Sarah Park <sarah@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, legal@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch cadence & ops handoff — Alliance Shelf listing

Hi Jasmine & team,

Great to hear — excited to get moving. Quick answers and materials attached:

- Product pack: included in CloudBridge-Listing-Materials.zip (logos, 2x screenshots, 1-pager). Files follow Redwood sizing guidelines except we have both light/dark variants of the icon.
- Pricing/SKUs: attached inside a pricing tab in the zip; provisional mapping to Starter/Pro/Enterprise. We currently bill monthly; happy to provide expected usage numbers (we’ll send estimates for next 6 months by EOD Friday).
- Security: attaching our SOC2 attestation and a short summary of our data retention policy.
- Legal contact: legal@cloudbridge.com (CC’d). Procurement prefers Redwood’s standard marketplace order form — we’ll flag any redlines quickly.

Questions for ops:
1) Does Redwood require marketplace-ready container images or is a hosted SaaS listing acceptable?
2) Is there a hard cutoff for image/screenshot resolution? We saw some variance between AWS and GCP docs.

Proposed launch: target submission to GCP marketplace on Aug 2, subject to QA. Can you confirm that timeline works on your side?

Attachments: CloudBridge-Listing-Materials.zip (logo/png, screenshots/png, onepager.pdf), CloudBridge-SOC2-2027.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Sarah Park
Head of Partnerships
CloudBridge Solutions
sarah@cloudbridge.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@cloudbridge.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch cadence & ops handoff — Alliance Shelf listing

Thanks Sarah — everything looks good from the materials list. Quick operational plan and asks before the intake call: 

- Ops sync: 30m on Monday 2028-07-24 at 10:00 PT. Calendar invite to follow.
- Action items for CloudBridge before the sync: fill the entitlement CSV Ben attached, confirm 6-month usage estimates, and upload the final logos/screenshots to the Drive link below.
- Legal: we prefer Redwood’s marketplace order form for speed — I’ll open the DocuSign envelope and route to legal@cloudbridge.com; expect a signature roundtrip within 3 business days if no redlines. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/contract/ABC-12345

Drive (assets + intake form): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AaBbCcDdEeFF
HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/884422/companies/45321

I’ll add our listing ops engineer (ops-listings@redwoodinference.com) to the intake thread after we confirm the sync. Thanks everyone — short and focused meeting should get us to submission.

Attachments: none in this message; earlier attachments referenced: Redwood-Marketplace-Launch-Checklist.xlsx, Marketplace-Entitlement-Mapping.csv, CloudBridge-Listing-Materials.zip
